title: Positron Emission Tomography (NaF-18) to Identify Bone Metastasis of Cancer
item_service_description:
<p><strong>A. General</p></strong>
<p>Positron Emission Tomography (PET) is a minimally-invasive, diagnostic imaging procedure that assesses the level of metabolic activity and perfusion in various organ systems of the body. A positron camera (tomograph) is used to produce cross-sectional tomographic images, which are obtained from positron-emitting radioactive tracer substances (radiopharmaceuticals) such as F-18 sodium fluoride (NaF-18).</p>
